description: Client-side JavaScript code for detecting IE browser version, loading XML documents, manipulating XML data, and transforming XML with XSLT for UI rendering.

methods.name: detectIE
methods.description: Detects Internet Explorer browser version based on user agent string.

methods.name: loadXMLDoc
methods.description: Loads an XML document synchronously via XMLHttpRequest or ActiveXObject.

methods.name: dotstarremove
methods.description: Replaces numeric parts in object names with '.*' for pattern matching.

methods.name: displayResult
methods.description: Loads and transforms XML data into HTML using XSLT, with extensive DOM and localStorage manipulations for UI rendering.
